behaviors_proven.interrupted_task_resume: task left in running/ requeued to pending/ with _recovery_attempts=1 and timestamp (live synthetic acceptance via --recover-only)
behaviors_proven.lock_contention: second daemon refused with exit 1 while a live pid holds the lock (live synthetic acceptance + unit test)
behaviors_proven.persistent_logs: JSONL daemon_log.jsonl with daemon_started/recovery/task_*/daemon_stopped events; daemon_state.json updated through lifecycle
behaviors_proven.recovery_exhaustion: task exceeding max recovery attempts moves to failed/ with _recovery_exhausted (unit test)
behaviors_proven.stale_lock_recovery: lock held by a dead pid is detected stale and replaced (live synthetic acceptance + unit test)

limitation: resume requeues the whole task; mid-cycle resume of a partially executed loop is not implemented
objective: Crash resume, locking, persistent logs for the daemon candidate
synthetic_acceptance: queue with stuck running task + stale dead-pid lock + stale state -> run_task_queue_daemon.py --recover-only -> recovered_count=1, task back in pending with attempt count, lock released, state=stopped, logs persisted; second-instance contention refused (RC=1)
